Arasaka Prototype Variable Assault Rifle.name: Fusil d'assaut modulable prototype Arasaka
Arasaka Prototype Variable Assault Rifle.description:
The Arasaka Prototype Variable Assault Rifle is an Excellent Quality Assault Rifle. Assuming you have all the parts, it can use an alternate unique railgun mode.

Railgun Mode requires:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.mlYhAxuDlI3fP9hq]{Arasaka Prototype Heat-Resistant Barrel}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.8nSzcjNlyulWrZtN]{Arasaka Prototype Railgun Upgrade}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_upgrades.Item.nQF0M9n7cLvHS5RY]{Arasaka Prototype Rechargable Battery}

Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana.name: Katana Larme tranchante Arasaka
Arasaka Weeping Reaver Katana.description:
Excellent Quality Two Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon.

Contains three refillable chambers in the hilt for storing proprietary blade coatings:

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_ammo.Item.wIMBD44ZU3iJ6jNI]{Arasaka Acid}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_ammo.Item.9diHOp9hSafmHRqC]{Arasaka Fire}

  • @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_ammo.Item.LumJXCKgGQTLZJWu]{Arasaka Wound Salt}

E-TACK Public Defender.name: Défenseur de l'ordre E-TAQUE
E-TACK Public Defender.description: This weapon lacks a mechanical trigger and requires a Subdermal Grip to operate. The installed Smartgun Link comes equipped with both Lethal and Non-lethal settings.

Eagletech Survivalist.name: Survivant Eagletech
Eagletech Survivalist.description: The Eagletech Survivalist is a 2-in-1 Crossbow and Assault RIfle. It is incapable of Autofire. It comes with an integrated Sniping Scope.

Faisal's Dead or Alive.name: Mort ou Vif de Faisal
Faisal's Dead or Alive.description: The Faisal's Dead Or Alive is a Poor Quality Shotgun with an integrated Poor Quality Net Launcher.

Faisal's Magna Knuckles.name: Poing de magma de Faisal
Faisal's Magna Knuckles.description: One Handed Exotic Medium Melee Weapon. Battery powered EMP effect which can deactivate cyberware. @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.other_macros.Macro.z8NN97JkdZUUFYud]{Get EMP'd Items}

Federated Arms Pepper Shaker.name: Sulfateuse Federated Arms
Federated Arms Pepper Shaker.description: The Federated Arms Pepper Shaker is an Exotic SMG incapable of single shot or aimed shots. Autofire only use 6 bullets for this weapon.

Georgia Arms Matchmaker.name: Entremetteuse Georgia Arms
Georgia Arms Matchmaker.description: Poor Quality Exotic Shotgun that only holds one shot in the magazine.

GunMart Bubba Buster.name: Explose-tronche GunMart
GunMart Bubba Buster.description: Poor Quality Exotic Shotgun that destroys itself if fired more than 3 times in a minute.

GunMart Door Cracker.name: Enfonceuse de porte GunMart
GunMart Door Cracker.description: Cheap explosive item, small area of effect.

GunMart Engage Rocket Launcher.name: Lance-roquettes Briscard GunMart
GunMart Engage Rocket Launcher.description: Poor Quality Exotic Rocket Launcher that explodes on a Critical Failure or when unloading the weapon.

GunMart Smart Special.name: Smartspécial GunMart
GunMart Smart Special.description: The GunMart Smart Special is a Poor Quality Heavy Pistol with an integrated Smartgun Link.

GunMart Special.name: Spécial GunMart
GunMart Special.description: The GunMart Special is a Poor Quality Heavy Pistol.

Hades Multipurpose Assault Shotgun.name: Fusil à pompe d'assaut multifonction Hadès
Hades Multipurpose Assault Shotgun.description:
Shotgun. The magazine holds 16 shots.

Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

Kendachi Mono-Guard.name: Monogarde Kendachi
Kendachi Mono-Guard.description:
Monowire, One Handed Exotic Heavy Melee Weapon.

Can apply multiple Critical Injuries.

Kendachi Mono-Katana.name: Monokatana Kendachi
Kendachi Mono-Katana.description:
Two Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon protected by a biometric key.

When wielded by the correct user the weapon ignores armor less than 7 SP.

Kendachi Mono-Star.name: Monoétoile Kendachi
Kendachi Mono-Star.description:
Mono-Shuriken whose orb center contains a kinetic and solar motor allowing the star to spin on itself and vibrate.

Can be used as both a melee and ranged weapon.

Kendachi Mono-Wakizashi.name: Monowakizashi Kendashi
Kendachi Mono-Wakizashi.description: One Handed Exotic Heavy Melee Weapon. When wielded by the correct user the weapon ignores armor less than 7 SP.

KillChip 100 Micro-Bomb.name: Microbombe Puce-tue-le 100
KillChip 100 Micro-Bomb.description: Memory chip, but explosive when plugged into Neuralware.

KTech TechHammer.name: TechHammer KTech
KTech TechHammer.description:
The KTech TechHammer is an Exotic Shotgun/Rocket Launcher.

Magazine holds either 4 Shotgun slugs/shells, or 2 Smart Rockets.

Micro Hydrogen Combustor.name: Micro catalyseur à hydrogène
Micro Hydrogen Combustor.description: A small explosive that detonates after being immersed in a liquid. Is both armor piercing and creates a large cloud of smoke.

Midnight Arms Beast Shotgun.name: Fusil d'assaut Golgoth Midnight Arms
Midnight Arms Beast Shotgun.description:
The Midnight Arms Beast is an Shotgun that holds holds 40 rounds in its magazine. Requires BODY 10 or higher (unless mounted) when fired or the User will suffer the consequences.

Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

Militech Fox Dual Ammo Pistol.name: Pistolet à double munition Renard Militech
Militech Fox Dual Ammo Pistol.description:
The Militech Fox Dual Ammo Pistol is a Heavy Pistol.

Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

Militech Mastiff SMG.name: Pistolet-mitrailleur Mastiff Militech
Militech Mastiff SMG.description: The Militech Mastiff SMG is an Two-Handed SMG and Shotgun.

Militech Perseus.name: Persée Militech
Militech Perseus.description:
The Militech Perseus is an Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol.

This weapon has a 2 ROF if it has been fired in the previous round.

ModFire 10X (Pistol).name: ModFire 10X (Pistolet)
ModFire 10X (Pistol).description:
The ModFire 10X is an Exotic Heavy Pistol that can also be transformed into an Exotic SMG or an Exotic Assault Rifle.

The ModFire 10X and all its components fit neatly into a sleek @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.black-chrome_gear.Item.RVr6mvr9BQ6hgS1L]{carrying case}. Transforming the weapon from one profile to another takes 1 minute as long as you have all the requisite parts.

Nomad Rocker.name: Rocker nomade
Nomad Rocker.description: The Nomad Rocker is a Poor Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol that fires rocks. Ammo is free for this weapon.

OUTLet Explosive.name: Adaptateur EX(plosif)
OUTLet Explosive.description: Explosive look-alike of an electrical plug adapter.

Overlord Handcannon.name: Canon de poing Overlord
Overlord Handcannon.description:
The Overlord Handcannon is a Poor Quality Exotic Heavy Pistol with a ROF of 1. It may give a +1 bonus to Facedowns* in certain situations.

⚠️ Creating an ActiveEffect to modify Reputation is known to cause a bug when adjusting the ledger.

Pursuit Security Bouncer.name: Foudre de paume Pursuit Security
Pursuit Security Bouncer.description:
Battery powered glove.

One Handed Exotic Combination Stun Baton and Microwaver. @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.other_macros.Macro.z8NN97JkdZUUFYud]{Get EMP'd Items}

Pursuit Security Incorporated Crowd Bust.name: Contrôleur de foules Pursuit Security Incorporated
Pursuit Security Incorporated Crowd Bust.description: The Pursuit Security Inc. Crowd Buster is an Assault Rifle with a unique alternate firing mode. It comes with a free pair of @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.NYxdMQPHdjnpYNLE]{Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors}.

Ranger Combat Boomerang.name: Boomerang de combat Ranger
Ranger Combat Boomerang.description:
Acts like a one Handed Exotic Heavy Melee, though halves SP despite being thrown.

Contains a built in guidance system.

Rostović Kleaver.name: Hachoir Rostović
Rostović Kleaver.description:
Two Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon. Can use a battery pack to increase damage.

Need BODY 11 or more to use it.

Rostović Street Destroyer.name: Rostović Street Destroyer
Rostović Street Destroyer.description:
The Rostović Ulični Uništitelj (Street Destroyer) is a Poor Quality Shotgun. The magazine only holds 3 shots. It can only shoot Shotgun Shells.

Incompatible with magazine upgrades.

Sanroo Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 Assault Pist.name: Pistolet d'assaut Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 de Sanroo
Sanroo Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 Assault Pist.description:
The Sanroo Hello Cutie Ultra-K8 Assault Pistol is an Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol with an Excellent Quality Heavy SMG mode. +2 Bonus to Wardrobe & Style if you are wearing 3 or more Asia Pop clothing items.

Switching Autofire modes on or off takes an Action to complete.

SlamDance FangFist.name: Poing à lame SlamDance
SlamDance FangFist.description:
Excellent Quality One Handed Exotic Medium Melee Weapon.

A glove with a short retractable blade.

SlamDance Tasmanskiy Klô.name: Tasmanskiy Klô SlamDance
SlamDance Tasmanskiy Klô.description:
Excellent Quality Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon.

Big retractable blades in a Combat Glove.

Solo Wolf and Bot Mono-Katana.name: Monokatana Solo Wolf and Bot
Solo Wolf and Bot Mono-Katana.description:
Poor Quality Two Handed Exotic Very Heavy Melee Weapon.

Mono-Katana cheap look-alike.

Sternmeyer M-04 Variable Assault.name: Fusil d'assaut modulable M-04 Sternmeyer
Sternmeyer M-04 Variable Assault.description:
The Sternmeyer M-04 Variable Assault is a Poor Quality Exotic Assault Rifle with a custom Grenade Launcher underbarrel.

Only accepts Scope upgrades

Superchrome® Glam Rifle.name: Fusil glam Superchrome
Superchrome® Glam Rifle.description:
The Superchrome® Glam Rifle is an Assault Rifle. It gives the user a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style when equipped.

Note: Superchrome effects do not stack and will need to be managed in the Effects tab if multiple Superchrome items are installed.

Superchrome® Javelin.name: Javelot Superchrome
Superchrome® Javelin.description:
The Superchrome® Javelin is a Sniper Rifle. Gives the user a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style when equipped.

Note: Superchrome effects do not stack and will need to be managed in the Effects tab if multiple Superchrome items are installed.

Superchrome® Sidearm.name: Pistolet Superchrome
Superchrome® Sidearm.description:
The Superchrome® Sidearm is a Very Heavy Pistol. Gives the user a +2 bonus to Wardrobe and Style when equipped.

Note: Superchrome effects do not stack and will need to be managed in the Effects tab if multiple Superchrome items are installed.

Techtronika Russia BMG-500.name: Mitrailleuse Browning 500 Techtronika Russia
Techtronika Russia BMG-500.description: The Techtronika Russia BMG-500 is an Exotic Assault Rifle with a magazine of 500 rounds and a bipod. Requires BODY 11 or higher (unless mounted).

Tommyknocker.name: Poltergeist
Tommyknocker.description:
The Tommyknocker is a combo Exotic Very Heavy Pistol and Poor Quality Shotgun. Has one empty slot for handgun upgrades.

Requires BODY 10 or to be held in two hands when firing, otherwise the user drops the weapon to the ground.

TR-4 Detonator Fluid.name: Fluide de détonation TR-4
TR-4 Detonator Fluid.description: Must be poured into a fuel tank vehicle to explode.

Utility Tomahawk.name: Tomahawk multifonction
Utility Tomahawk.description:
Blade and pike, this steel and composite ice axe can help you climb ice walls while also doing serious damage in a fight.

Can be used as both a melee and ranged weapon.

Westwood.name: Westwood
Westwood.description: The Westwood is an Excellent Quality Very Heavy Pistol. 6 shot capacity that can't be upgraded with magazine attachments. Contains a pull-out screen concealed in the grip.

White Hornet Tanto.name: Tanto Frelon blanc
White Hornet Tanto.description:
One Handed Exotic Medium Melee Weapon.

Can render target unconscious rather than dead.

Zhirafa Rhinocefist.name: Rhinopoing Zhirafa
Zhirafa Rhinocefist.description: Armored large stone chisel glove, covering from hand to shoulder. Requires interface plugs. Can be used both for demolition and brawling.
